user.title: Xiaomi MiMo TTS
user.description: Uses the Xiaomi mimo-v2-tts model. Supports Chinese and English. You may set a default style below. If not set, or if you prepend a style tag to the message in each tts.say call, the per-call style takes precedence.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Xiaomi MiMo TTS
reconfigure.description: Update API key, URL, and default style.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed (401) — check API key and Authorization header
error.bad_request: Bad request (400) — check request format, parameters, and model name
error.forbidden: Access denied (403) — region not supported or API key blocked by risk control
error.content_filtered: Content blocked (421) — content moderation rejected the input
error.rate_limited: Rate limit exceeded (429) — too many requests, try again later
error.server_error: Server error (500/503) — MiMo service failure, retry later
error.cannot_connect: Network error — cannot reach the MiMo API (see logs for details)
